action: Attend the one-hour listening meeting with Councilmember Maria Santos. Present the Millfield Auto Tech Pipeline proposal in its strongest form: the EV/hybrid/electronics curriculum redesign, the ASE certification pathway alignment, the two-stage HS-to-community-college pipeline structure, and the RoboRide deployment data as evidence of local demand. Listen to what grant criteria she is working with and offer to reshape program documentation to match that language specifically. Make one clear ask: formal endorsement from her office and a pathway application to link the program to the $150K workforce transition fund or any successor retraining grant. Offer to provide whatever written materials — enrollment projections, equipment cost estimates, job placement data from alumni — her office needs to make the case internally. Leave her with a one-page program summary she can share with the grant administrator.
